text:
ash: Heads-up: discovered a reproducible failure in the Node sample app when we rapidly reconnect after auth refresh (~50-250ms). Parser sometimes emits fragmented chunks out of order and we end up with two final tokens. Repro and notes below.

vik: Can you paste the tiny repro? Is this happening in browser too?

ash: Minimal repro used EventSource loop: connect -> close after 120ms -> reconnect after 100ms. After ~200 iterations we see JSON parse errors and duplicate final marker.

nora: Logs? That sounds like a reconnect race where the old TCP socket still pushes the tail of a chunk after the new connection starts emitting.

ash: Trimmed log: chunk X (partial) arrives, auth refresh triggers new conn, chunk Y from new conn parsed first, then leftover of X arrives and gets processed as a separate fragment -> out-of-order assembly.

vik: We have `bufferChunks` toggles in SDK. Did you try enabling full buffering?

ash: Yep. Buffering reduces frequency but doesn't eliminate it because the SDK swaps parsers on reconnect without ensuring the previous stream has finished emitting.

nora: Quick mitigation idea: add an opaque per-chunk sequence header from the server and drop any chunk with seq <= lastSeen on client. That prevents duplicate final emits until we fix reassembly.

vik: Also consider a tiny grace period (30-70ms) to let the old socket drain before accepting new data; risky but cheap to try behind a feature flag.

ash: I'll open a small patch with `seqDropOnReconnect` flag default off, and a repro script in the sampleapp. Will also file an issue.

ops-bot: Created ticket RED-2201: "sampleapp: fast reconnect causes chunk fragment reordering" and attached logs.

ci-bot: Suggest adding a flaky e2e that randomizes reconnect delay and fails if duplicate finals observed.

nora: Long-term we should update parser to support fragment reassembly across reconnects when `Last-Event-Id` is present, or ensure auth refresh sends a clean delimiter before swapping connections.

vik: Agreed. Short-term: feature-flag seq-drop + CI coverage. ash, assign reviewers?

ash: Assigning @vik and @nora. I'll push the branch and drop the repro at `devex/sampleapp/repro/fast-reconnect-frag.js`. Please review. :thumbsup:
